perspective:

- Later, Keith observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He told her he was glad they talked and that he was always available for a chat or break. She thanked him, said it meant a lot, and said she felt better knowing she had his support.
- Based on these interactions, Keith believes Elizabeth values his support, feels more comfortable around him, and he intends to maintain this supportive relationship.
